ZinStdIO.Reader: Explicit read(destination []u8) !usize style interface discovered by comptime duck typing.
ZinStdIO.Writer: Explicit write(source []const u8) !usize and writeAll(source) !void style interface discovered by comptime duck typing.
ZinStdIO.StdStreams: stdout stderr stdin are target-provided stream objects and do not require libc.
ZinStdIO.Formatting: std.io writer print delegates to std.fmt compile-time checked formatting.
